# DavPanel

> DavPanel is a web hosting control panel built on Docker. Every hosting user gets a fully isolated environment - dedicated web server, database, PHP-FPM, private network, and storage - delivering VPS-grade isolation on shared hardware. It ships as a free Community edition and a paid Enterprise edition for hosting providers, priced per server rather than per account.

This is the main DavPanel website. For technical documentation, see davpanel.com/docs.

## About DavPanel

DavPanel started in 2023 as a LAMP-stack panel and moved to one Docker container per user service (web, database, mail), giving each hosting user real isolation without the overhead of a container per website.

Key facts:
- Free Community edition, plus Enterprise from a fixed €14.95/month per server - no per-account fees
- One Docker container per user service: web server, database, PHP-FPM, mail
- Linux installer paths: Ubuntu Server 22.04/24.04/26.04 LTS, Debian 12/13, AlmaLinux/Rocky Linux 9/10, Oracle Linux 10 and CentOS Stream 9/10; Fedora/openEuler experimental
- No OS/version has a completed clean-server DavPanel acceptance run; Rocky Linux currently requires --skip-firewall and a separately configured firewall
- amd64 and arm64 release builds; native arm64 hosting unverified; Codespaces and containers are development/build environments
- REST API with 160+ endpoints, plus a native MCP server for AI agent management (since v1.7.65)
- Billing automation for WHMCS, FOSSBilling, and Blesta
- Not open source: DavPanel UI and DavAdmin are distributed under a EULA; davcli and configuration files are CC BY-NC (non-commercial)

---

## Product

The core control panel: a Docker-isolated environment per hosting user, managed through DavPanel (user-facing) and DavAdmin (server administration).

- [DavPanel](https://davpanel.com/): A highly customizable web hosting control panel built around Docker containers.
- [Integrations & Features](https://davpanel.com/features/): Browse DavPanel's integrations and features - billing, DNS, mail, backups, and more.

---

## Editions & Pricing

DavPanel ships as a free Community edition and a paid Enterprise edition, priced per server rather than per hosting account. Billing-software integrations automate account provisioning.

- [DavPanel Community Edition](https://davpanel.com/community/): DavPanel Community edition is a free web hosting control panel, suitable for VPS and private use.
- [DavPanel Enterprise](https://davpanel.com/enterprise/): DavPanel Enterprise Edition provides robust user isolation and management features, designed for web hosting providers, all at a fixed price.

---

## Compare DavPanel

How DavPanel's Docker-per-user model differs from CloudLinux-based and traditional shared-hosting control panels.

- [DavPanel vs cPanel/WHM: Alternative Hosting Panel Compared](https://davpanel.com/cpanel-alternative/): Compare DavPanel vs cPanel/WHM: Podman-based per-user isolation, native ARM support, and a fixed €14.95/month price per server - no per-account fees or hikes.
- [DavPanel vs Plesk: Alternative Hosting Panel Compared](https://davpanel.com/plesk-alternative/): Compare DavPanel vs Plesk: true per-user Podman isolation, native ARM support, and one fixed €14.95/month price per server - no per-account licensing fees.
- [DavPanel vs DirectAdmin: Alternative Hosting Panel Compared](https://davpanel.com/directadmin-alternative/): Compare DavPanel vs DirectAdmin: Podman-based per-user isolation, a full REST API and MCP server for AI agents, priced per server, not per account.
- [DavPanel vs CyberPanel: Alternative Hosting Panel Compared](https://davpanel.com/cyberpanel-alternative/): Compare DavPanel vs CyberPanel: real per-user isolation without CloudLinux, granular permissions, and enterprise support from €14.95/month per server.
